Cohen Edwards (born November 23, 2010) is a Canadian alto saxophonist and guitarist. He is a member of the Whitehorse all-city jazz band, and the Whitehorse all-city senior band.
Early life
Cohen Edwards was born in Edmonton Alberta, Canada. From a young age, he developed an interest in music and began learning the alto saxophone, which became his primary instrument.
Music career
Cohen Edwards is an alto saxophonist who has participated in organized band programs and musical ensembles.
He has performed with:
* Whitehorse All-City Jazz Band
* Whitehorse All-City Senior Band
These ensembles bring together musicians to perform concert band and jazz repertoire
